scope: ARM64 API35 redroid, same app UID and Debian, app-private ext4, count=1000, 64 MiB sequential transfers. Seven alternating quadruples; 224 observations. current=b8ea fstat experiment with -0, close=8ca5 probe with -0 and untraced close, identity=b8ea without -0 or FSTAT_ENTRY, identity-close=8ca5 without -0 or FSTAT_ENTRY and with untraced close. stat/path/rename options remain enabled. No diagnostic output during speed runs; warm cache. Not production validation.
limitations: Untraced close omits auxv/netlink bookkeeping and pipe shadow handling; restricted to disposable file workloads, not a general runtime.

Identity modes change visible UID/GID, permissions and application behavior. Device Python TarFile.chown checks geteuid()==0 before user/group resolution and ownership changes. Faster tar is not evidence of identical-work engine acceleration.
No package installation, arbitrary networking, guest ptracer or general pipe correctness validation for this probe. Production payload and user runtime configuration unchanged.

virtual_uid_1000_spot_check.scope: One subsequent run with -i 1000:1000, FSTAT_ENTRY enabled, close still traced. Illustrative only, not a seven-run comparison.
